questions_and_answers.question_text: In what special sense is jiànshè mostly used?
What is the crucial difference between rénmín and rénmen?
Whose scope does rénmen roughly match?
How does fāzhǎn differ from fādá?
Write the Chinese for "We want to build China into a modern socialist nation."

answers.answer_text: Wǒmen yào bǎ Zhōngguó jiànshèchéng yíge xiàndàihuàde shèhuìzhǔyì guójiā.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "The Chinese government is working hard to develop industry."

answers.answer_text: Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ zài nǔlì fāzhǎn gōngyè.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Which is the action verb and which the adjectival verb?

answers.answer_text: Fāzhǎn is the action verb ("to develop"); fādá is the adjectival verb ("to be developed").
Yes — it refers to the broad masses and lower-level cadres, and excludes state and class enemies.

articles.text:
6. A: Xiànzài, gǎo jīngjì jiànshè    Today, engaging in economic construction
      hái shi Zhōngguó rénmín zuì    is still the most important work of the
      zhòngyàode gōngzuò a!          Chinese people!
   B: Shì, suīrán zhèixiē nián      Yes, although the pace of development
      fāzhǎn sùdù hěn kuài, kěshi    has been very fast the past few years,
      jīngjì hái shi wǒmende         the economy is still the main focus of
      gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn.             our work.

Notes on No. 6

jiànshè: "to construct, to build up; construction." This is mostly used in a SPECIAL SENSE: to construct or BUILD UP A COUNTRY. The jargon "socialist construction" conveys an attitude toward the "MISSION" facing the country: to build China from the ruins left by a semi-feudal, semi-colonial society into a socialist power.

Wǒmen yào bǎ Zhōngguó            We want to build China into a modern
jiànshèchéng yíge xiàndàihuàde   socialist nation.
shèhuìzhǔyì guójiā.

rénmín: "the people." DISTINGUISH between RÉNMÍN and RÉNMEN.

  — RÉNMEN (with the plural ending -men) refers to ANY AND ALL people, WITHOUT class implications. Its scope is about the same as dàjiā, "everyone."
  — RÉNMÍN, on the other hand, refers to THE BROAD MASSES and lower-level cadres, and EXCLUDES state and class enemies.

Zhōngguó rénmín xīwàng néng      The Chinese people hope to be able to
shēnghuóde āndìng.               live peaceful and settled lives.

fāzhǎn: "to develop, to grow." In the Society module you learned the ADJECTIVAL verb FĀDÁ, "to be developed." Now you see the ACTION verb for "to develop."

Zhōngguó zhèngfǔ zài nǔlì        The Chinese government is working hard
fāzhǎn gōngyè.                   to develop industry.
Tā yánjiū fāzhǎnzhōng guójiāde   He studies the economic situation of
jīngjì qíngkuàng.                developing countries.
